intent.text: warm late-afternoon sun, blue-violet shadows, readable, never black or washed

avenue-rim.name: Street
avenue-rim.description: Marble avenue from the stair head to the temple front

limestone-canyon.description: The canyon terrain repainted with vertex colours: pale grey-tan stratified limestone on the cliffs, turquoise-sand floor, olive scrub on the rim.

hellenic-townhouse.description: Detailed Mediterranean/Hellenic town house facing +Z: rusticated stone base, plastered walls with quoins, string courses, dentil cornice, windows with frames, mullions, lintels, sills and louvred shutters, a doorway with pilasters, pediment and steps, upper-floor French door with iron balcony, wall lantern, tiled gable or hip roof with overhang, fascia and ridge cap, or flat roof with parapet and pergola, plus chimney.

variant.description: 0 gable tile roof, 1 hip tile roof, 2 flat roof with parapet and pergola

doric-temple-detailed.description: Detailed Greek Doric peripteral temple: 4-step worn marble crepidoma, 8x17 fluted entasis columns with echinus/abacus capitals (a few chipped drums), architrave, triglyph/metope frieze with guttae and faint gold discs, mutule cornice, sculpted pediments with 9 relief figures, gilded palmette acroteria, barrel-tile gabled roof, cella with pronaos and dark door, and three navy banners with gold emblems.

width.description: front width of the stylobate in meters

length.description: length of the flanks in meters

height.description: total height to the apex acroterion in meters

limestone-canyon-repaint.description: The canyon terrain's exact heightfield (same params and seed as the built-in terrain, variant 3) repainted with per-vertex colour: ivory and grey fractured limestone with horizontal strata streaks, olive vegetation patches on ledges, an olive and dry-grass rim, and sage at the base. Trimesh collider.

limestone-terrain-v2.description: Built-in canyon terrain (exact same heights via api.library) repainted per-vertex: ivory and grey fractured limestone with horizontal strata, olive vegetation patches on the rim and ledges, sage and sand low down. Trimesh collider.

cart.description: Detailed wooden hand cart with a planked bed, raised side rails, iron-rimmed spoked wheels, axle hardware and two long pull handles.
